sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
- Easter eggs and References: The jacket appears to be modeled after one manufactured by SITKA and is possibly a cross between the "Incinerator Aerolite" and "Hudson" jackets, the gloves are modeled on an older version of Mechanix Coldwork Original.
- The original name of this tactical clothing was "USEC Crusader".
- During development, the symbol on the hand-warmer was a Knights Templar shield.
